purpose: Explicitly record decisions required before any canonical CIR/EIR correction or staged OAI expansion. This is a decision-request ledger, not a record of approvals.
rules: All decisions start pending; no approval is inferred from this file or its presence in a pull request.
A decision may be marked approved only by an authorized owner with a recorded identity, date, rationale, and evidence reference.
Conflicting evidence lifecycle claims remain disputed until an authorized adjudication is recorded.
No canonical CIR/EIR, staged GDR/OAI, or migration-map change is authorized by this gate.
